searchText: Hey noticed that for config/spec route each client returns a self selected list of items. For example LH: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/blob/bac7c3fa544495a257722aaad9cd8f72fee2f2b4/consensus/types/src/chain_spec.rs#L941 Should the API spec provide this list? That sounds a bit unmantainable but could help have more cohesion Lodestar's validator client compares the beacon's spec with the local spec to ensure they match, but we have to intersect them instead of equal due to the issue above hmm, it should be the constants, presets and config items from the spec. Though the spec does change those without any concern for backwards compatibility so things do get a little entertaining at times. It is definitely an API you need to ignore unrecognised items as new things can (and have) appear at any point.
